name: TimelineSelector
description: Dropdown for picking the dashboard time range. Wraps `core/Select` and the canonical option list from `getTimelineOptions`. Controlled: the page owns the selected timeline and passes it to its queries

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called whenever the user picks a new option

props.name: options
props.description: Available options — defaults to {@link getTimelineOptions}. Pass a custom list to localise labels or restrict the range

props.name: label
props.description: ARIA label / placeholder for the trigger

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind/BEM class hook on the trigger
